mapper.select: SELECT name, reason FROM RECOMMEND_FOOD WHERE sake_no=#{sakeNo} ORDER BY no

SELECT s.no, s.name_ko AS nameKo, s.name_ja AS nameJa, s.sake_type AS sakeType, s.rice_ko AS riceKo, s.rice AS rice, s.polishing_ratio AS polishingRatio, s.yeast_ko AS yeastKo, s.yeast AS yeast, s.sake_meter_value AS sakeMeterValue, s.acidity, s.alcohol_percentage AS alcoholPercentage, b.name_ko AS breweryNameKo, b.prefecture, ( CASE
WHEN s.sake_type IN
#{type}
THEN 3
ELSE 0 END
+
CASE
WHEN ( srp.sake_meter_max IS NULL OR srp.sake_meter_max >=#{sakeMeterMin} ) AND ( srp.sake_meter_min IS NULL OR srp.sake_meter_min <=#{sakeMeterMax} ) AND ( srp.sake_meter_min IS NOT NULL OR srp.sake_meter_max IS NOT NULL ) THEN 2
ELSE 0 END
+
CASE
WHEN ( srp.acidity_max IS NULL OR srp.acidity_max >=#{acidityMin} ) AND ( srp.acidity_min IS NULL OR srp.acidity_min <=#{acidityMax} ) AND ( srp.acidity_min IS NOT NULL OR srp.acidity_max IS NOT NULL ) THEN 2
ELSE 0 END
+
CASE
WHEN ( srp.polishing_ratio_max IS NULL OR srp.polishing_ratio_max >=#{polishingRatioMin} ) AND ( srp.polishing_ratio_min IS NULL OR srp.polishing_ratio_min <=#{polishingRatioMax} ) AND ( srp.polishing_ratio_min IS NOT NULL OR srp.polishing_ratio_max IS NOT NULL ) THEN 1
ELSE 0 END ) AS score
FROM SAKE s
JOIN SAKE_RECOMMEND_PROFILE srp ON srp.sake_no=s.no
LEFT JOIN BRAND br ON br.no=s.brand_no
LEFT JOIN BREWERY b ON b.no=br.brewery_no
ORDER BY score DESC,s.no
LIMIT 40

SELECT s.no, s.name_ko AS nameKo, s.name_ja AS nameJa, s.image_url AS imageUrl, s.sake_type AS sakeType, b.prefecture, s.polishing_ratio AS polishingRatio, s.acidity, s.alcohol_percentage AS alcoholPercentage, b.name_ko AS breweryNameKo, rs.reason FROM RECOMMEND_SAKE rs JOIN SAKE s ON s.no=rs.sake_no LEFT JOIN BRAND br ON br.no=s.brand_no LEFT JOIN BREWERY b ON b.no=br.brewery_no WHERE rs.food=#{food} ORDER BY rs.no
